{"behavior":"answer","answer":"You can’t change your PIN at an ATM. To change it, open the NovaPay app, go to **Cards**, select your card, tap **PIN** and then **Change PIN**.","cited_article_ids":["card-pin"]}

{"behavior":"answer","answer":"If you see a duplicate charge, first check with the merchant to confirm it wasn’t a separate purchase. If the merchant can’t help, open a dispute for the extra payment. {"behavior":"answer","answer":"To transfer money from an outside bank, open the **Add money** section in the app, select **Bank transfer**, copy the account details shown for the currency you want to send, and then send the money from your other bank using any reference shown in the app.","cited_article_ids":["topup-by-bank-transfer"]}

{"behavior":"answer","answer":"If you see a 4‑digit number on a bank statement that you don’t recognize, it could be a card number or a reference code. Check the details of the transaction.
